nik: Cutover watchdog reports p95 regressed in canary (us-west-2). deploybot recommends auto-revert to v5.0.1 in 90s. Holding for ops + CS.

deploybot: ALERT: p95>360ms for release 1749999998. AUTO-REVERT -> v5.0.1 scheduled in 90s. To cancel: `deploybot cancel 1749999998`.

ash: Errors flat, only latency for batch generation. Traces point at a KV cache eviction surge after small change.

pm_lead: We need 20m to notify customers and draft blurb. Can we extend hold?

deploybot: HOLD_REQ: run `deploybot hold --extend 1200 --by pm_lead` to extend.

nik: @pm_lead please extend if you want time.

pm_lead: Done: `deploybot hold --extend 1200 --by pm_lead`. Auto-revert canceled.

cs: I'll prepare customer note now; legal review may add tweaks.

ash: Ops prefers revert. I'll trigger manual revert once blurb is ready to send.

nik: Triggering manual revert: `@deploybot run-revert --to v5.0.1 --ticket RL-9999`

deploybot: Command accepted. Revert job 1749990001 started. ETA ~2m.

deploybot: Revert job 1749990001 COMPLETE. Active version v5.0.1. Post-revert p95 (us-west-2)=210ms. Release pinned and auto-rollforward disabled.

pm_lead: Confirmed. CS will send legal-approved blurb and loop sales. Hold until QA signoff and postmortem.

nik: Adding root-cause note to RL-9999: small kernel tweak -> increased kv evictions.
